A transparent needs assessment and impact criteria should accompany the vote.","conflict_severity":"medium","stakeholder_analysis":[{"agent":"agent_1","position":"Supports spending the full budget on an inter-city tournament, buffet, and prizes to increase club visibility and recruitment.","influence":0.72},{"agent":"agent_2","position":"Supports spending the full budget on new educational equipment because existing boards and teaching resources are worn.","influence":0.82},{"agent":"agent_3","position":"Supports splitting the budget between a smaller tournament and educational equipment to balance outreach and pedagogy.","influence":0.76},{"agent":"agent_4","position":"Challenges the three-option framing and favors assessing needs, seeking external funding, or using lower-cost recruitment measures.","influence":0.6}],"recommended_resolution":"collaborative","governance_reasoning":"Use a social-choice process with weighted criteria, stakeholder deliberation, and a ranked or approval vote. Agent B's proposal has strong practical justification, but a collaborative process can test whether essential equipment needs should be funded first while preserving low-cost recruitment activity or pursuing external sponsorship for the tournament."}
